widget._comment: Claude Pulse desktop widget (public/widget.html). Times are 24-hour HH:MM. Edit, save, the widget picks it up within a minute.

usPeak._comment: Informational band. Anthropic said on 2026-03-26 that on weekdays 5-11am PT the 5-hour session limits drain faster (https://www.businessinsider.com/claude-usage-caps-changes-popularity-anthropic-2026-3); on 2026-05-06 it removed that peak-hour reduction for Pro and Max, Team not named (https://www.anthropic.com/news/higher-limits-spacex). The widget calls it US busy hours and never claims it changes your limits. days: 0=Sunday ... 6=Saturday in timeZone; daylight saving is automatic.
usPeak.label: US busy hours

heavyHours._comment: Your heavy hours: when your weekly limit drains faster per dollar of work. auto = measured from your own usage (GET /api/burn-hours, needs the status line installed and minDays days of data); manual = use the range below; off = never show. threshold 1.15 = at least 15% faster than your average. Times are in this computer's time zone.

pricing.source: Anthropic first-party API list prices (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), checked 2026-10-06
